description: This file defines the XTextFormatter class, a simple text formatting and rendering utility for PDF documents within the PdfSharp library. It handles text layout, line breaking, and alignment for drawing text in PDF graphics.

classes.name: XTextFormatter
classes.description: A simple text formatter for laying out and drawing text within a specified rectangle in PDF graphics.

classes.name: Block
classes.description: Represents a segment of text or a line break used internally for layout processing.

methods.name: XTextFormatter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the formatter with a graphics context.

methods.name: DrawString
methods.description: Draws the specified text within the layout rectangle with optional formatting.

methods.name: CreateBlocks
methods.description: Splits the text into blocks for layout, handling line breaks and whitespace.

methods.name: CreateLayout
methods.description: Calculates line and paragraph layout, including line breaking and alignment.

methods.name: AlignLine
methods.description: Aligns a line of text to left, center, right, or justify within the layout rectangle.
